archive_scope_note: The supplied EfficientNet archive lacked complete per-fold metrics, interval outputs, calibration outputs, figures, epoch-wise training histories, and full runtime records. The prediction-level analyses and figures in this release were independently reconstructed from the audited fold-assigned probabilities, fold assignments, and other available provenance; the raw prediction file retains a legacy OOF filename.
training_history_note: Available training-history records were incomplete and insufficient to reconstruct genuine epoch-wise learning curves or exact stopping behavior.
